messages:
emily-pmm: Quick one — SilverLine case draft needs final quote + legal on a single performance callout. Draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/SilverLineCase (wip). Can we lock this today?

tamika: I can get a 15m soundbite from their Head of Product. They prefer we share suggested language first. Also want localization in EN/FR/DE.

emily-pmm: Suggested quote (draft) pasted in doc. Also proposing webinar 11/18 as launch tie-in. Ops, can you pencil that?

nate-legal: I glanced at the draft. Change any ~nn% phrasing to "approximately nn%" and add a parenthetical reference to the internal benchmark doc. Avoid superlatives like "best". 24h turnaround if nothing else is flagged.

tamika: Customer ok with suggested edits. Draft quote now: "Moving to Redwood improved our median latency and increased throughput by approximately 48% (internal benchmark, Nov 2025), letting us ship more features without additional infra." Marked for legal.

emily-pmm: Great. Ops, please reserve a 45m prep + recording slot the week before the webinar. Sales-ops, we want inbound leads routed to Enterprise SDRs and a short playbook in the doc.

ops-bot: Recording slot held: Nov 11 10:00 PT, 45m. Invites sent to emily-pmm, tamika, silverline-contact@example.com. Locales: EN/FR/DE noted.

sales-ops: Confirmed routing plan: campaign starts 2025-11-19 09:00 PT to Enterprise SDRs. Add a 2-bullet playbook (focus on integration ease + cost-saving ROI).

nate-legal: Legal-approved with edits: replaced "median latency" -> "median inference latency" and confirmed the parenthetical. Final approved quote: "Moving to Redwood improved our median inference latency and increased throughput by approximately 48% (internal benchmark, Nov 2025), letting us ship more features without additional infrastructure." Marked in doc as legal-approved.

emily-pmm: Thanks all. Tamika, record the soundbite and add localized snippets. Sales-ops, once assets live, route a one-pager to SDRs. Staging checklist: finalize quote, embargo until 11/18 morning, localized assets, recording done.

tamika: Will capture recording and localize FR/DE captions by Nov 13.

emily-pmm: Perfect — handing to PR for scheduling after assets. :rocket:
